senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; redupl. of ידי; cmp. דּוֹד) [pointed out,] chosen, beloved; chosen spot.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 53a:19">Men. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>יבא י׳ בן י׳ ויבנה י׳ … ויתכפרו בו ידידים</he> the beloved (Solomon), son of the beloved (Abraham), shall rise and build a chosen structure (Temple) to the beloved (the Lord) in the lot of the beloved (Benjamin), that in it the chosen ones (Israel) be atoned for.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:3:5">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Shabbat 137b:18">Sabb. 137ᵇ</cite> (benediction on circumcision) <he>אשר קידש י׳ מבטן</he> who sanctified the chosen one (Abraham, <cite ref="Isaiah 41:8">Is. XLI, 8</cite>; others: Isaac, with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 22:2">Gen. XXII, 2</cite>) from the womb.—Pl. <he>יְדִידִים</he>, v. supra.
